profile.headline: Passionate Full Stack Engineer | React, Django, JavaScript | Experienced in Ecommerce UX, Digital Platforms & Modern Web Architecture  | AI-Assisted Development with Claude Sonnet 4.6
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with a passion for leveraging cutting-edge technologies to elevate user experiences. Demonstrated success in implementing solutions that drive revenue growth. Committed to utilizing technology as a catalyst for positive change and advancement for businesses with an online presence. Transitioned from marketing via a coding bootcamp, currently work in the home building industry and started a part time resale clothing business, bringing with me a unique perspective and diverse problem-solving skills.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software for the building industry to help boost sales and reduce costs

Work on mybldr.com, a digital platform for builders to access 3d home previews, view material estimates, order tracking,  job scheduling, coordinate tasks and view home plan documents.

positions.title: Genba Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading provider of assisted reality solutions for frontline industrial workers

Architected and built a global search API using Elasticsearch and Django, along with a sophisticated UX for displaying results to display orders, machine parts, comments and any other metadata needed by technicians to service existing assets

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Voice-enabled workflow mobile application for Industrial Maintenance Technicians allowing technicians to accurately speak their way through jobs and eliminate traditional paperwork

Built and supported a RESTful API taking unstructured text and converting into Django model fields using Regex to store and query user comments entered in work orders

positions.title: CRM Application Developer
positions.description:
Architected and built a custom dashboard using React and Javascript to enhance marketing pipeline visibility of 43K+ leads and customers
Supported integration between Dynamics 365 and accounting that processed $1-$3 Million worth of grant expenses using .Net/C# to maintain data integrity 
Maintained code base for 11 internal teams using Agile practices
Communicated with project leads among other departments to gather requirements and ensure frictionless production deployment

positions.title: Marketing Associate
positions.description: Responsible for digital inbound lead conversion among 91 schools

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Taught in person and online 5-20 students with little to no experience per class the basics of HTML, CSS, and Javascript
Engaged students in person and online over 2 hour period to help with comprehension of subject matter

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description: Responsible for driving the full sales cycle from prospecting to close from a pipeline of 3,000+. Booked over $26,000 in advertising revenue.

positions.title: Fleet Manager
positions.description:
Collaborated with load planner to route or pre-plan freight to ensure on-time service.
Monitored compliance for 30+ employees on company policies and Department of Transportation regulations.
Motivated employees to meet weekly mile expectation, reduce idle time, decrease turnover, and increase efficiency.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Created an inclusive environment of academic and professional achievement as well as promoting safety at all times by providing resources, creating awareness, and enforcing school wide safety procedures.
